description:
Learn every bird in your country, then compete with friends and fellow birders.

Most bird apps name the bird for you. Motmot trains you to do it on your own. Pick a country and it quizzes you with real photos, videos and sounds of all the birds recorded there, from the common garden birds to the rarities. You get feedback on every answer, extra practice on what you get wrong, and you can play head to head in real time, with friends in a Flock, or in the National League. Free, open source and without ads.

EVERY BIRD OF YOUR COUNTRY
Quizzes are built from the full bird list of each country and region, so you learn every species you could really see, not just a top 100. Ideal for your local patch and before a birding holiday. Start with the common species and work up to the rare ones.

LEARN WITH FEEDBACK
• Five levels, from Beginner to Expert, where you type the name yourself
• Focus on one family, such as warblers, gulls or raptors
• Compare lookalikes side by side after a wrong answer
• Tricky Birds remembers which species you confuse and gives you extra practice on them
• My Checklist tracks every species you recognise and miss

COMPETE
• Live multiplayer: challenge friends head to head in real time
• Flocks: bird clubs and friends get a private group with a shared weekly quiz
• National League: the same birds for everyone in your country, climb the leaderboard
• Country Challenge and Daily Challenge
• Survival: one wrong answer and your run is over

PHOTOS, VIDEO AND SOUND
See each bird in real photos and videos, and learn its song and calls from xeno-canto recordings.

YOUR LANGUAGE
The app speaks English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese and Japanese, and shows bird names in more than 75 languages or as scientific names.

Whether you are learning the birds in your garden, getting ready for a bird survey or sharpening years of fieldcraft, Motmot helps you recognise more birds with confidence.

How many birds can you identify?
